connector.name: Snaprender
connector.registryDescription: Screenshot, extract content, and render web pages. PNG/JPEG/WebP/PDF, batch, signed URLs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package snaprender-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the user0856 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
